entries.subject: DAMIT 6127: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 6127, version 2022-02-14, pole (199°, 6°), period 21.8756 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 6128 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 120.093 ± 0.79 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 120.093 ± 0.79 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: Armida whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 20 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.951 at 462 nm, 1.006 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#31302f in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.4%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
